definitions.explanation: The time when the sun disappears below the horizon in the evening.

examples.japanese: {日没|にちぼつ}{前|まえ}に{帰|かえ}ろう。
{日没|にちぼつ}は{午後|ごご}6{時|じ}ごろです。
{日没|にちぼつ}から{日|ひ}の{出|で}までを「{夜|よる}」という。
examples.english: The period from sunset to sunrise is called 'night.'

notes:
{日没|にちぼつ} is a formal/technical term for sunset.

WORD FORMATION:
{日|にち} (sun, day) + {没|ぼつ} (sinking, setting) = {日没|にちぼつ}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日没|にちぼつ}{前|まえ}/{後|ご} - before/after sunset
- {日没|にちぼつ}{時刻|じこく} - sunset time
- {日没|にちぼつ}と{同時|どうじ}に - at sunset

{日没|にちぼつ} VS {日|ひ}の{入|い}り VS {夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ:
- {日没|にちぼつ} - formal, technical term for the moment the sun sets
- {日|ひ}の{入|い}り - standard word for sunset
- {夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ - dusk, twilight (the period around sunset)

OPPOSITE:
- {日|ひ}の{出|で} / {日出|にっしゅつ} - sunrise
